description: How punctual direct trains between two Polish cities were over the last 30 days (e.g. Gdańsk – Kraków, Warszawa – Zakopane): on-time share, typical delay, cancellations, trains per day. Covers the 100 most popular routes, each direction separately; if only the opposite direction is covered, that one is returned and marked.
name: poland_route_punctuality
title: Punctuality of trains on a route in Poland
